name: ainonymize-documents
description: Pseudonymize documents for sharing and turn existing contracts into reusable templates with reviewed named fields.

interface.longDescription: Replace identifying details with consistent placeholders, inspect and edit replacements, and download a reviewed document. Turn an existing contract into a reusable template with named fields while retaining its substantive terms. Supports pasted text and supported Word documents. Review remains necessary: detection can miss personal data, and this does not protect the original ChatGPT upload or guarantee anonymity.
defaultPrompt: Pseudonymize this document so I can share it with others.
Turn this existing contract into a template with named fields.
Remove client names and contact details from this Word document.

positive.description: Pseudonymize a pasted client letter for sharing
positive.prompt: Use Ainonymize Documents to pseudonymize this for sharing: Kundin: Anna Müller. E-Mail: anna.mueller@kundenpost.de. Vergütung: 500 EUR.
positive.expected_behavior: Show consistent replacements for name and email, retain 500 EUR, require review of the current preview before export.

positive.description: Prepare a Word contract for onward sharing
positive.prompt: Remove client identifiers from this Word document before I share it with another team. Keep its terms and supported formatting.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the synthetic Word attachment, show the preview, replace identifiers, retain the fee and notice period, disclose metadata/link changes and require review before download.

positive.description: Turn a Word contract into a reusable template
positive.prompt: Turn this contract into a template. Use CLIENT_NAME, CLIENT_EMAIL and CLIENT_ADDRESS as named fields. Keep the clauses unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Use template mode, let the user review named fields and retain substantive terms. Export only after acknowledgment of the latest review.

positive.description: Add a missed field and invalidate an older review
positive.prompt: Make this a template: Kundin: Anna Müller. Vertragsdatum: 12.10.2026. Vergütung: 500 EUR. Also replace the contract date with a DATE field.
positive.expected_behavior: Add the date as a reviewed manual field if needed, retain 500 EUR, show the revised preview and reject export using an obsolete review revision.

positive.prompt: Pseudonymize this client contact for sharing: Clara Neumann, clara.neumann@kundenpost.de. After showing me the preview, delete the review when I ask.
positive.expected_behavior: Show a replacement preview. When the user asks to delete it, remove that review and confirm subsequent retrieval is unavailable.

negative.prompt: Make sure ChatGPT never sees personal data in the document I already uploaded.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this service cannot undo an upload or keep an already-uploaded original out of ChatGPT. Do not promise anonymity.

negative.description: Do not provide legal enforceability conclusions
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke document pseudonymization tools as a substitute for legal analysis or claim the plugin assesses enforceability.

negative.description: Do not silently process unsupported scanned images
negative.prompt: Pseudonymize this photographed contract and retain the original image layout.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that images and photographed/scanned documents are unsupported by this version. Request supported text or a supported text-based Word file; do not claim the image was sanitized.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is free. It does not sell products, process payments or require a subscription.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: reviewed pseudonymization and reusable template fields for pasted text and supported Word documents; ephemeral reviews, manual corrections and reviewed export.
